option.dev: Development mode (warn about missing translations on stderr)
option.datadir: Explicitly set the TTS data directory (Mods)

status.description: Check the TTS editor connection and the current save

datadir.description: Locate and select the TTS data directory (Mods)

option.set: Write the given path straight into the config file

pull.description: Pull all Lua scripts and UI files from the current save into a directory

exec.description: Run a Lua snippet in the current save (global script)

assets.description: Inventory asset URLs referenced by the save (optional liveness check)

option.check: Check URL reachability over the network (HTTP 2xx)
option.sample: Only check a random sample of N URLs

error.missingArgument: Missing required argument or option value: {argument} (run --help for usage)

status.portInUse: Port {port} is already in use: close the program occupying it (usually another tts-toolkit instance) and retry
status.notRunning: No running TTS editor detected: start the game and open the Editor first

pull.empty: Nothing to pull: already up to date
pull.notConnected: Cannot pull scripts: not connected to the TTS editor

exec.timeout: Lua execution timed out after {seconds}s: the script may be stuck in a loop, or blocked by an in-game dialog
exec.multipleReturns: Lua returned {count} values; only the first is used (the rest are ignored)
exec.notConnected: Cannot run Lua: not connected to the TTS editor

assets.empty: No asset URL references found in the current save
assets.invalidSample: Invalid sample size: {value} (must be an integer ≥ 1)
assets.notConnected: Cannot inventory assets: not connected to the TTS editor

datadir.title: Select the TTS data directory
datadir.multiple: Multiple usable TTS data directories found:
datadir.written: Data directory written to config: {path} (config file: {config})
datadir.none: No valid TTS data directory found: make sure the game is installed, or pass --datadir <path>
datadir.prompt: Enter a number and press Enter (1-{max}; press Enter to cancel):
datadir.invalidChoice: Invalid input: enter a number between 1 and {max}
datadir.nonInteractive: Not an interactive terminal: use --set <path> to set the data directory

error.notConnected: Not connected to the TTS editor (port {port})
